bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12", one-gallon clear freezer bags, non-clear bags up to 6" x 9", and qualifying empty hydration packs are allowed. Other bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Empty hydration packs with no more than two main compartments and one smaller compartment
prohibited: Bags outside the published size and compartment limits
bagPolicy.note: All guests are subject to TSA-style security screening.

parking.note: The 2026 festival is at Hollywood Park adjacent to SoFi Stadium, 1011 Stadium Dr., Inglewood. Use the current official travel page for paid parking, shuttle, and arrival options before departure.

rideshare.note: Use the current HARD Summer travel instructions and the signed Hollywood Park event rideshare areas; pickup traffic controls may change during egress.

concessions.note: HARD Summer is cashless and sells food and beverages inside the festival. Outside food, beverages, alcohol, candy, glass, cans, cups, and coolers are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited paid ADA parking is available first-come in all festival lots for vehicles with a valid state-issued placard, permit, or plate; the credential holder must be present.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: No re-entry or ins-and-outs are permitted on the same festival day.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: For 2026, the box office is open 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Saturday and 1:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m. Sunday at Hollywood Park.

gates.title: Entrance & Hours
gates.body: HARD Summer takes place at Hollywood Park adjacent to SoFi Stadium, 1011 Stadium Dr. Event hours are 2:00–10:00 p.m. Saturday and Sunday; arrive early for TSA-style screening.
